# Forge2D Template v0.1.0

Release date: 2026-08-28

Forge2D Template v0.1.0 is the first reviewed public release of the repository's
minimal Godot 4 project baseline and repository-local Python tooling.

## Highlights

- Safe cross-platform setup inspects Python, venv/pip, Godot 4, and declared
  packages while keeping Python changes inside `.venv`.
- The minimal runtime baseline provides an application composition root, a
  named scene router, a neutral template-home route, and headless integration
  coverage without imposing a game-specific architecture.
- Mandatory Python and GDScript standards are enforced by `g2d style` inside
  the standard `g2d check` gate.
- Reviewed Godot 4.7.2 presets and `g2d export` produce validated Linux,
  Windows, and universal macOS outputs at fixed ignored paths.
- Named keyboard/controller InputMap actions and an optional coordinate-free
  touch adapter provide remappable navigation, movement, accept, cancel, and
  pause intent with documented deadzones and accessibility guidance.
- Protected `main` accepts pull-request changes only after all eight Linux,
  Windows, and macOS CI jobs pass.
- Contribution and security policies, focused GitHub issue forms, an active
  pull-request template, and private vulnerability reporting provide clear
  review and coordinated-disclosure paths without publishing personal contact
  credentials.
- Concise GitHub description/topics and a versioned metadata guide make the
  template discoverable while telling downstream owners which identity,
  homepage, security, and protection settings to customize.

The complete change list is in
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/kleiveist/Forge2D-Template/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.md).

## Downloads

| Asset | Target |
| --- | --- |
| `Forge2D-Template-v0.1.0-linux-x86_64` | Linux x86-64 |
| `Forge2D-Template-v0.1.0-windows-x86_64.exe` | Windows x86-64 |
| `Forge2D-Template-v0.1.0-macos-universal.zip` | macOS universal x86-64/arm64 |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 digest for every platform asset |

Download all four files and verify each platform artifact against
`SHA256SUMS.txt` before use. The documented
[release procedure](../releasing.md) includes an independent Python verification
command. Linux users may then need `chmod +x
Forge2D-Template-v0.1.0-linux-x86_64`, because a direct GitHub download does not
carry a Unix executable permission bit.

## Signing Limitations

These first-release game exports are validated but are not production-signed.
The Linux executable has no distribution signature, the Windows executable has
no Authenticode signature, and the macOS bundle has only Godot's ad-hoc signature
without Apple notarization. Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper can therefore
warn or block the downloads. Review the
[export signing guidance](../exporting.md#signing-notarization-and-distribution)
before redistributing them as trusted production binaries.
